name: MySQL / MariaDB
description: Connections, queries and traffic from SHOW GLOBAL STATUS
hint: Runs the mysql client as the SSH user. Put credentials in ~/.my.cnf on the server (a [client] section with user and password, mode 600), or use a user with socket authentication.
command: mysql -NB -e "SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Threads_connected','Threads_running','Questions','Slow_queries','Aborted_connects','Bytes_received','Bytes_sent','Uptime')"
